title: Escape portal build plan
eyebrow: How the arrival portal will close and the hidden escape portal will open, as you approved on 2026-10-29 (picks 1A, 2A, 3A, and your own answer to 4)
approval: Build plan approved: hidden escape portal

short.lead: The portal stays one object, the ExtractionZone, and it moves: open at the arrival for the first 20 seconds, closed, then open in a room deep in the castle for the last minute, as the Ophan arrives. Every machine already has the raid clock, so each one decides open, closed and where from the clock and the raid seed, and nothing new is sent over the network. Leaving reuses today's countdown, cut from 8 seconds to 4. The sounds already exist in the project. Four build steps, then a recorded co-op run. One choice is yours.
short.hint: Tap an item to see what each step does.
items: The arrival portal closes at 20 seconds

Issue #552. When 20 seconds of the raid have passed (the guards' grace, GuardArrivalGrace), the portal at the arrival closes on every machine: its look goes out with the existing collapse sound (sfx_portal_collapse_01), and standing in its spot starts no countdown. An editor test checks the open and closed rule against the time elapsed.

Issue #553. When the castle is built, behind the loading card, every machine ranks the rooms by walking distance from the arrival along the guards' map (CastleNavGraph) and picks one of the farthest third with the raid seed. It is never the arrival room. An editor test checks that the same seed gives the same room and that the room is in the farthest third; host and client log the room they picked.
The escape portal opens as the Ophan arrives

Issue #554. With 60 seconds left, the moment the Ophan arrives, the portal moves to the chosen room and opens with the portal-opened sting. It plays the existing portal hum (amb_portal_loop_01) as a 3D sound that grows louder as you get nearer, and its light lights its room and spills through open doorways, with no beam above the roofs.
Pick how far away the hum can be heard, under Choices.
Leaving, and leaving your friends behind

Issue #555. Standing in the escape portal runs a 4-second countdown (now 8). When it ends, everyone on the pad leaves with what is in the portal, the raid ends and the portal closes. Anyone not on the pad is left behind, which the game already counts and the Lair's last-raid line already reports.

Issue #556. One recorded raid with the Editor hosting and a built client, both windows in the recording: the arrival portal closing at 20 seconds, the escape portal opening in the same room on both, one player leaving and the other left behind. I read it frame by frame, then send you a QA page with the clips.

changes: Open at the arrival for the whole raid
Open at the arrival for 20 s, closed, then open deep in the castle for the last minute
Picks the room from the seed.
The farthest third by walking distance, never the arrival
A new small class beside CastleArrivalPlanner, with its editor test.
The raid clock, the Ophan's arrival time, the left-behind count, the Lair's last-raid line, the loading card and the scene split.
choices: How far away can the hum be heard?
Faintly across most of the castle
Heard up to about 60 m away, very quiet at that range and loud close up. You can tell which way to go from anywhere, and it grows as you close in.
Heard up to about 25 m away. Far away you hear nothing, so you have to search before the sound helps.
I suggest A: you asked for a sound that grows louder as you get closer, which helps most if it can be heard from the start.

wrapup.summary: Four build steps and a recorded co-op run: the arrival portal closes at 20 seconds, a hidden portal opens deep in the castle with a minute left, and leaving takes 4 seconds and can strand your friends.
wrapup.changing: Where the portal is and when it is open, and the leaving countdown. The Ophan, the clock and the loading card do not change.
wrapup.blocking: Your pick for how far the hum can be heard.
wrapup.next: Issue #551 (The arrival portal closes and a hidden escape portal opens) is open, with steps #552 to #556. I build them in order on AjsAgent/gym-with-demand-page, then send you the QA page.
